role: Classifies strap errors that mean 'feature not ready yet' (safe to retry on the same link) versus real failures.
toplevel: PolarErrors / BleGattException checks compiled only under #if canImport(PolarBleSdk).

units.does: True for PolarManager.PolarError.featureNotReady, PolarErrors.notificationNotEnabled, PolarErrors.deviceError whose description contains 'notificationNotEnabled', and BleGattException.gattDisconnected; false otherwise.
units.entry: Used as catch-where predicate in StrapLinkCoordinator.whenFeatureUsable (StrapLinkCoordinator.swift:389); tested by EmuquTests/StrapErrorClassifierTests.swift.

branches.effect: true: switch decides; false: next check
returns whether description contains 'notificationNotEnabled' (string match on SDK text)
true: inner check; false: falls to return false
true: returns true; false: returns false
